scope: Five-prototype engineering decision; no production runtime guarantee
required_record_fields: Firmware binary/hash, recipient public-key identifier and option-byte readback; never record private keys
Battery seller/part/lot and measured initial condition
Storage part/lot and formatted usable bytes
Case revision and verified thermal interface configuration
Ambient and pack-contact temperature; start/end timestamps
Raw traces, complete encrypted recording set and authenticated import report
preconditions: Electrical bring-up and charger/protection review completed before battery runtime testing
Use the onboard charger configuration, not a laboratory4.2V top-up; log actual end voltage and termination
Temperature contact, inhibit response and sensor fault handling validated separately before unattended charging
No USB power or debugger back-power during discharge test; measurement setup must not alter cutoff or radio/clock state
Final production build and provisioned encryption recipient; synthetic VID/PID link fixture is not suitable
Five exact batteries/prototypes available; no purchase authorized by this plan

tests.purpose: Continuous full-system recording from actual onboard charge
tests.units: Each of five prototypes at declared nominal ambient; report every unit, not only best
method: Charge using device until normal termination and record charge profile
Disconnect all external power and begin independent elapsed-time measurement
Present externally logged time-coded audio interleaved with deliberate silence; never use silence suppression
Log battery voltage/current and buffer-overrun/drop counters throughout at qualified bandwidth
Continue beyond16h until orderly stop; preserve final chunk and record cutoff reason
Import/decrypt all chunks and compare decoded samples, chunk sequence, acquisition counters and audio time markers
acceptance: Each tested unit records at least57600seconds continuously without recharge
No dropped/overwritten audio buffers or unexplained gaps; intentional silence remains represented
Every committed recording authenticates and decodes as mono16kHz-or-higher audio
Measured sample clock and duration reconciliation documented; nominal WAV header alone is insufficient
Charge/discharge electrical limits and qualified thermal bounds remain satisfied
report_limits: Five samples do not establish lifetime/worst-case runtime guarantee
Repeat at declared operating-temperature endpoints and defined ageing condition before broader claim
Capacity110mAh divided by average current is not an observed runtime

tests.purpose: Actual encrypted36h retention on selected storage
method: Begin with documented card filesystem/cluster size and usable capacity
Record36h of continuous audio using external power where needed; this does not count as battery endurance
Authenticate/decode all25920 five-second chunks, compare sequence and source markers
Remount and repeat enumeration; verify no plaintext audio files or temporary plaintext remnants in firmware write paths
acceptance: All36h recoverable without overwriting previous material

tests.purpose: Power negotiation and storage ownership transitions
method: Exercise attach/detach, suspend/resume and charging at low battery
Verify charge permission only after allowedUSB current state and measured total input current within advertised budget
Exercise physical cable loss during transfer and repeat import
Check recording/storage ownership excludes simultaneous unsafe host/device writes
acceptance: No source loss or authentication failure after retry
No unapproved charging state or electrical-limit violation
tests.existing_evidence: Host unit tests do not replace USB hardware tests

tests.purpose: Recover committed recordings across interrupted save
method: Use controlled supply fixture first; interrupt across encryption/write/sync/rename stages
Restore power and verify allpreviouslycommitted files, bounded incomplete-tail handling and next recording ID
Repeat on the exact selected storage hardware
acceptance: Incomplete file never presented as complete
No unbounded startup recovery or IDreuse

method: Use retail batteries spanning measured cable/pack variation
Follow supplied assembly guide with no soldering, wirecutting or connectorreplacement
Inspect pinching, housing seating, acoustic opening and thermal contact after closure
acceptance: Assembly succeeds without modifying retail battery
Case closure cannot load or disconnect plug
Thermal contact remains valid after handling and declared mechanical test

release_rules: Mark each test PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN with raw evidence; no blank field implies success
Resolve size requirement with user before case release
Separate engineering prototype readiness from verified16h product claim
Any failed runtime/size requirement triggers alternatives and user consultation, not silent specification change
